assets.screen: 07.1 Đặt chỗ đỗ xe cá nhân

figmaChanges: Completed the existing parking screen with a confirmed reservation and check-in instructions; the previous placeholder content remains hidden for recovery.
Added booking and check-out screens using the existing student AppHeader, Input, Button, Stat, StatusChip and DataFreshness components.
Reused Ocean Mobility tokens and Be Vietnam Pro text styles. The new content is native editable Figma layers, not a flattened screen image.
scope: UI only. Sequence, activity and state diagram placeholders remain unchanged for later teammate submissions.
modelingNotes: Reservation validity is at most 20 minutes from confirmation; the booking preview does not claim to hold a space before a successful request.
Check-in requires a valid reservation and confirmation of vehicle presence at the assigned space.
Check-out requires confirmation that the vehicle has left. A faulted space is not automatically made available.
Displayed countdowns and sensor states are illustrative static mockup data; no IoT flow, timer or business-state mutation is implemented.
The report contains one representative UI per UC, with no added activity/sequence explanatory text.
studentNavbarNote: Same six menu labels and order on all signed-in desktop student screens; active item follows current page. Public Hub lookup remains available.
